discovery_control.prior_proxy: 30-day Deribit DVOL applied as flat volatility to BTC/ETH daily thresholds
discovery_control.interpretation: The high hit rate concealed rare full binary losses and is not evidence of edge. No prior DVOL row enters this forward surface cohort.

market_scope.polymarket_contracts: active threshold_daily markets with a numeric strike, known resolver boundary and published fee/minimum metadata
market_scope.deribit_selection: calls at two strikes on each side and expiries bracketing each Polymarket strike/expiry, maximum 160 subscriptions
market_scope.raw_capture: 100ms public ticker WebSocket frames in durable WAL

valuation.model: cash digital under a lognormal risk-neutral distribution
valuation.strike_interpolation: linear in IV over log strike
valuation.uncertainty: Deribit bid/mark/ask IV envelope plus live Chainlink-versus-Deribit resolver basis +/- 3 bps
valuation.benchmark: conservative fair bound minus full executable Polymarket ask walk
valuation.fees: current per-market fee curve stressed at 2x; unknown schedule fails closed
valuation.hedge: rounded spot/perpetual base quantity equal to negative model delta
valuation.residual_risk: spot/IV/resolver-basis scenario CVaR retained per observation; delta hedge never labels binary gamma or settlement basis as risk-free

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across asset, side, horizon, surface fidelity and latency profile
evaluation.capacity: reported from displayed Polymarket depth and Deribit hedge depth; never extrapolated from win rate
evaluation.promotion: Passing permits a separately reviewed tiny live canary; this manifest grants no live authority.
evaluation.zero_edge_disclosure: A zero or negative result is plausible and must be reported without retuning this cohort.
